trigger: Final full-mode sweep reported algo8.1 mode2/canvas0 and algo8.10 mode1/canvas0 blank in both themes.
rootCause: The two direction toggles called Graph.set with only directed. Its documented replacement semantics rebuild missing nodes/edges as empty arrays, so the graph is deleted; changing the direction back does not recover it.
repair: Pass the existing G.nodes and G.edges together with the new directed value. Graph.set increments its version so adjacency indexes rebuild under the new direction. Current node positions and user-created/deleted edges are retained; algo8.10 resets/recomputes its DFS trace after the graph update.

mathematicalChecks: algo8.1 keeps10vertices/11edges and each directed degree sum11, with asymmetric a→e reachability; native insertion gives12edges and preserves them across mode changes.
algo8.10 retains14edges; undirected DFS has7tree+7back,0forward+0cross and14/14 timestamp agreement. Native removal yields13edges with13/13 agreement across modes.
validation.pixelChecks: A native drag changes canvas pixels. After native edge edit, direction toggle+restore yields exactly the same canvas PNG dataURL as before the round-trip, for both items and themes.
validation.inspection: All26after screenshots inspected via four item/theme contact sheets; individual light8.1 directed and dark8.10 undirected originals also inspected. Graph nodes/edges remain visible, direction/classification encoding changes, and the edited geometry persists.
